title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(河並崇研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kawanami Takashi)
educationalGoal: In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to IT systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an IT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.
advice: In this project, students learn R&D methods in IoT field. Specific research areas focused in this project are as follows: 1. FPGA architecture and CAD. 2. Wearable devices development and analisys for sports and health care. 3. Educational materials on embedded systems and STEAM. 4. Tourism informatics 5. e-sports support 6. Development of embedded systems in cooperation with local communities.
requiredKnowledge: Major achievements are the results of small and daily achievements. Students are recommended to conduct self-checking every quarter.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set a project schedule based on a set research topic goal.
Be able to set an appropriate approach or method for the project.
Be able to acquire the IT knowledge and skills needed for proceeding with the project.
Be able to deal with the problems that will occur in the analysis and design process.
Be able to evaluate the result from subjective and objective viewpoints for better understanding.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students with ideal achievement levels can conduct research activities smoothly based on a set plan and schedule designed autonomously and can present outcomes that are novel, useful, and reliable at academic meetings.
achievementLevels.standard: Students with standard achievement levels can conduct research activities based on a set plan and schedule, and can present the outcomes that showcase a meaningful and academic or engineering idea.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
